scripts.doctor: npm run build && npm run test:config
scripts.docs:screenshots: cross-env JEKYLL_ENV=production npm run build:cloudflare && node tests/capture-screenshots.cjs
scripts.test:compat: npm run build:test && cross-env SITE_ROOT=_site-test node tests/compatibility.cjs
scripts.verify: ruby --version && bundle --version && npm run test:edge && npm run test:hostile && npm run build && cross-env QUIET_EXPECT_PLACEHOLDER=1 npm run test:config && cross-env EXPECT_DEMO=0 EXPECT_CLOUDFLARE=0 npm run test:site && npm run test:feed
scripts.verify:cloudflare: ruby --version && bundle --version && npm run test:edge && npm run test:hostile && npm run build:cloudflare && cross-env QUIET_EXPECT_PLACEHOLDER=1 npm run test:config && cross-env SITE_URL=https://reader.example EXPECT_DEMO=0 EXPECT_CLOUDFLARE=1 npm run test:site && npm run test:feed
